# Distinct colors so adjacent PARTS of the same river are visually separable —

    for i, part in enumerate(parts):
        xs = [p[0] for p in part]
        ys = [p[1] for p in part]
        ax.plot(xs, ys, color=cmap(i % 10), lw=1.3, solid_capstyle="round")
        ax.scatter([xs[0], xs[-1]], [ys[0], ys[-1]], color=cmap(i % 10), s=8, zorder=3)
    ax.set_title(f"{title}  ({len(parts)} part{'s' if len(parts)!=1 else ''})", fontsize=10)
    ax.set_aspect("equal", adjustable="datalim")
